Running it
----------
This is for a Sharp MZ-2500 (or an emulator of one, such as EmuZ-2500).

  simcity.dsk     a disk image (2 sides, 40 tracks, 16 sectors of 256
                  bytes).  Boot the machine from it in drive 1.

The game uses the 320 x 200 screen in 16 colours, the YM2203 for the
sound effects, and the keyboard or the mouse.  The map is 96 x 96; there
are no scenarios.

Saving: a city is saved to one of eight slots kept in the last ten
cylinders of the boot disk itself (the disk must not be write protected;
with an emulator the image file is written to).  Give a name of up to
twelve letters; saving to a name that is already there replaces that
city, and the ninth name does not fit.  There is no list of the names,
so remember them.  Loading asks for the name.  This is untested on real
hardware.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters, sound
  Esc             the same as the right mouse button

The mouse
---------
The arrow on the screen is the cursor.  The keys move it too, so you can
use either, or both, whenever you like.

  Left button     (Space or Enter on the keyboard) builds with the
                  current tool, picks a tool from the icons, chooses an
                  item in a menu, and on a mini map jumps to that spot
  Right button    (Esc) opens the game menu, and leaves a screen
  Screen edge     the map scrolls when the arrow reaches the edge

In the menus and on the budget and evaluation screens, moving the mouse
works like pressing the cursor keys.
